debug.count_explanation: Generated exactly 20 distinct prompt texts. The set covers Home, Office, Education, Gaming, Café, and Creative Studio, with the strongest source-supported home prompts sorted first by source relevance, followed by adjacent and creative-departure environments.
ignored_fields: Run IDs, timestamps, export status, model names, and review status were treated as metadata.
Disclaimers and substantiation footnotes were not converted into scene props.
Brand/model/device identity and printer-specific hardware details were excluded from prompt text.
